image_description: A church interior featuring a central altar covered in white cloth, positioned on a raised red-carpeted platform. The altar is flanked by tall candlesticks and floral arrangements. Behind the altar is an ornate reredos with a stained-glass window depicting religious figures. The walls are light-colored with decorative patterns.
